summary.result: Main results are as follows. 1) There are several settlement reorganization policy measures, but many are still the model project stage, and not yet spread, so it is necessary to wait and see how these measures will develop. 2) The number of the residents of small-scale aging settlements who do not hope for the reorganization, nor feel the necessity of reorganization shall not be few.
summary.background: In the rural communities in less-favored areas (mainly hilly and mountainous areas) in Japan, the number of settlements which cannot maintain the community functions by themselves has been increasing because of the progress of depopulation and aging, so the necessity for achieving mutual supplementation of the community function by the settlement reorganization has been increasing.
summary.method: It is necessary to discuss among residents the activation plan and the future vision of the community, as well as to discuss the settlement reorganization.

summary_ko.method: 주민들 사이에서 공동체 활성화 계획과 미래 비전에 대해 논의하고, 침하 재조직화에 대해 논의해야 한다.
summary_ko.result: 주요 결과는 다음과 같다. 1) 여러 가지 침하 재조직화 정책 방안이 있으나, 대부분이 아직 모형 사업 단계에 머무르고 있어 확산되지 않았기 때문에 이러한 방안들이 어떻게 발전할지 지켜볼 필요가 있다. 2) 소규모 고령 침하 공동체의 주민 중 재조직화를 기대하지 않거나 재조직화의 필요성을 느끼지 않는 경우가 적지 않다.
